title: Recall: Translate parse errors into a domain error
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

required.clue: Inside a function returning Result<u32, ConfigError>, given input: Option<&str>, write the expression converting absence with ok_or to ConfigError::Missing and immediately propagating failure.

convert.clue: Given text: &str and imported ParseIntError, write an expression parsing a u32, mapping any parse failure through an explicitly typed ignored closure parameter to ConfigError::Invalid, and propagating failure with ?. Use the turbofish type argument.
